(4) If it appears from the report referred to in sub-rule (3) that-
(a) the statistical average of the net quantity contained in the packages drawn as
samples is lesser than the quantity declared on the packages or on the labels

(b) any such package shows an error in deficiency greater than the maximum
for good and sufficient reason, requested by the manufacturer or packer or his
authorized agent, so to do, take out as soon as may be practicable, fresh
samples and carry out fresh tests in accordance with the provisions of these
rules and where fresh tests are made, the Director, Controller or any L.egal
Metrology Officer, as the case may be, shall collect a fee of two thousand five
tests.
Provided that where fresh tests are carried out, no package contained in the lot,
which was previously tested under this rule, shall be sold or distributed by the
manufacturer or packer, as the case may be, unless the provisions of the sub-
rule (5) or as the case may be, sub-rule (6), are complied with.
